title: Oily Venezuelan Coconut Bread
description: A unique, ovo-vegetarian-friendly bread that balances bitterness with a rich coconut flavor, originating from the monsoon climate of Venezuela.

ingredients.name: All-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: Use an unbleached, low-protein flour for best results.

ingredients.name: Baking powder
ingredients.notes: Make sure the baking powder is fresh for optimal leavening.

ingredients.name: Large eggs
ingredients.notes: Crack the eggs into a separate bowl before adding them to the dry ingredients.

ingredients.name: Full-fat coconut milk
ingredients.notes: Use the thick coconut cream from the top of the can for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Active dry yeast
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality yeast for a lighter crumb.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Grapeseed oil
ingredients.notes: Use a neutral-tasting oil to avoid overpowering the coconut flavor.

ingredients.name: Shredded coconut
ingredients.notes: Toast the shredded coconut in a dry pan over medium heat for 5-7 minutes to deepen the flavor.

ingredients.name: Orange zest
ingredients.notes: Grate the orange zest over the bread before baking for a burst of citrus flavor.

instructions: Combine coco sugar, flour, baking powder, and salt in a large mixing bowl, whisking to incorporate.
In a separate bowl, whisk together melted butter, coconut milk, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Add the yeast and mix for an additional 10 seconds.
Add the grapeseed oil and mix for another minute.
Add the shredded coconut and orange zest and mix to distribute evenly.
Knead the dough for 10-12 minutes, until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rest in a warm place for 1 hour, until it has doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a round loaf.
Place the loaf on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Bake the bread for 35-40 minutes, until it is golden brown and sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom.
Let the bread cool on a wire rack for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
